goals.description: Make core Spec Creator artifacts machine-checkable.
goals.acceptance: A deterministic CLI/library validates preregistered core JSON/JSONL schemas and semantic invariants.

goals.description: Make frozen release integrity mechanically detectable.
goals.acceptance: The unmodified v0.03 contract passes canonical SHA-256 verification and all preregistered mutation fixtures fail.
Metric records reconcile to denominator snapshots, cutoffs, scopes, values, source events, and missing-data declarations; seeded mismatches fail.

goals.description: Convert recursive governance invariants into executable regressions.
goals.acceptance: Candidate self-certification and unguided regression retirement are rejected when represented in machine-readable records.

requirements.description: Validate JSON and JSONL syntax with artifact/line diagnostics.
Validate core records against Draft 2020-12 JSON Schemas.
Enforce stable IDs, controlled enums, duplicate detection, and cross-references.
Enforce event lifecycle and supersession consistency.
Enforce governed regression retirement and active critical regression resolution.
Validate denominator snapshots and metric-ledger reconciliation without treating missing data as zero.
Verify frozen-contract canonical SHA-256 and detect mutation.
Verify release-manifest file hashes and release-contract hash.
Detect candidate self-certification from release scorecard actor identity where mechanically observable.
Provide CLI and importable library with deterministic validation results and nonzero failure exit.
Provide automated valid/invalid fixture corpus covering preregistered failure classes.

failure_conditions: Any mandatory critical gate is FAIL or BLOCKED at release decision time.
Any applicable critical regression fails or disappears without an approved superseding decision.
A preregistered invalid critical fixture is accepted.
A preregistered valid fixture is rejected.
A mismatched or missing denominator is used as complete promotion evidence.
The evaluator actor is also an implementation actor.
The release manifest contains an unresolved content-hash mismatch.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS; PASS WITH ACCEPTED RISK is permitted only for noncritical documentary limitations explicitly recorded in the scorecard.
All primary metrics meet frozen targets.
All guardrail metrics meet frozen targets.
Metric ledger reconciles to frozen denominator snapshots and raw source events.
Release manifest and rollback declaration are complete.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.03 is rejected, v0.02 remains the active experimental parent; v0.03 files remain as failed evidence and are not rewritten. Original v0.01/v0.02 artifacts remain byte-identical.

hash_scope: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding the contract_hash property.
